# Java

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from java/lang.json and java/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//java:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//java:defs.bzl", "java_library", "java_binary", "java_test")
```

## Rules

### `java_library`

```python
java_library(name, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over java_library.

### `java_binary`

```python
java_binary(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over java_binary. main_class is inferred from the name and srcs when unset. -Xlint:all is on; warnings are errors unless warnings_as_errors is False.

### `java_test`

```python
java_test(name, *, srcs = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Minimal wrapper over java_test. test_class is inferred from the name and srcs when unset; the dx test runner runs unless use_testrunner = False. -Xlint:all is on; warnings are errors unless warnings_as_errors is False.

### `java_fuzz_test`

```python
java_fuzz_test(name, *, srcs = None, target_class = None, deps = None, visibility = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

A Jazzer fuzz target plus a `<name>_run` runner for `dx fuzz`. target_class is inferred from the name or the single src when unset.

### `java_bench`

```python
java_bench(name, *, srcs, deps = None, tags = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs the JMH benchmarks in srcs and writes dx-bench.json for dx bench.

## API docs

Tool: `javadoc`.

```python
load("@rules_dx//tools/docs/jvm:defs.bzl", "java_doc_shard")
```

### `java_doc_shard`

```python
java_doc_shard(name, lib, package = "", deps = [], **kwargs)
```

Declares the DocIr shard of one Java library.

Args:
  name: Name of the shard target.
  lib: The documented java_library.
  package: Package segment of every symbol id; defaults to the name of lib.
  deps: java_doc_shard targets of libraries whose types this one extends or links to.
  **kwargs: Common attributes such as tags and visibility.

Build the docs with `tools/dx docs`; see [docs](../cli/commands/docs.md).

## Dependencies

List the artifacts in a rules_jvm_external `maven_install.json` and run
`dx generate --apply`. The `java` language of `dx generate` writes the targets and `deps`.
A dependency is the label `@maven//:<group>_<artifact>`, with dots and dashes
turned into underscores, for example `@maven//:com_google_guava_guava`. See
[generate](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/generate.md).

## Quality

By default `dx format` runs `google_java_format`, `dx lint` runs `pmd`,
`spotbugs` and `typos`, and `dx typecheck` runs `javac`. `pmd` reads a ruleset bound
with `pmd_config`. Without one it reports unused private methods, fields, locals,
parameters and assignments as info. See the
[quality config table](https://github.com/devhusdk/rules_dx/blob/main/docs/cli/commands/quality.md).

## Bench and fuzz

`java_bench` runs JMH benchmarks for `dx bench`. JMH 1.37 comes with rules_dx, so no Maven hub entries are needed.

```python
load("@rules_dx//java:defs.bzl", "java_bench")

java_bench(
    name = "sum_bench",
    srcs = ["Sum.java"],
)
```

The test is tagged `dx-bench`, runs in the default test set and writes `dx-bench.json` with one row per `@Benchmark` method. It runs one warmup and three measurement iterations of 200 ms in the test JVM, without forking. `kotlin_bench` in `@rules_dx//kotlin:defs.bzl` and `scala_bench` in `@rules_dx//scala:defs.bzl` take Kotlin and Scala sources the same way. `size`, `timeout`, `args`, `env`, `flaky`, `jvm_flags`, `data` and `visibility` go to the test. Other attributes go to the library that compiles `srcs`. `tags` and `target_compatible_with` go to every target.
